## What's new

- Cheats: press MENU in a game and choose Cheats. Get Cheats finds the game in libretro's cheat database over Wi-Fi; each cheat has a switch that works in the game at once, and your choices are kept per game.
- Game Genie, Action Replay, GameShark and Code Breaker codes, and RetroArch's memory cheats. Your own .cht files go in Cheats/<console>/, or through ChaOS Transfer.
- Cheats shows only for games that have some. While a cheat has been on, achievements pause for the rest of that game.

---

ChaOS 2.1.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v2.1.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.1.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
